description:
What this is. Every accident or injury at work: who was hurt, when and where, what happened and how badly, the first aid given and any days off work.

Recording one can send the employee straight to the clinic — a clinic ticket is issued, more urgent the worse the injury. The Clinic Analytics page adds them up: lost-time injuries, days lost and where accidents keep happening.
name: Record Work Accidents
title: Work Accidents — record every injury at work
